previousAttempts.error: Could not reach the AI provider. Check your connection, and AI_BASE_URL if you set one.

observations: Résumé emphasizes React/TypeScript UI, workflow engineering, testing, Firebase, and CMS integration.
Selected experience and project prose was compared with source summaries and bullets; metadata remained source-owned.
Fit identifies absent accessibility evidence while recognizing documented frontend strengths.

cases.jobDescription: Automation Engineer at Example Operations. Required: Zapier, DocuSign, operational integrations, staff training, and reliable reporting workflows. Preferred: custom application development.

observations: Résumé prioritizes Zapier/DocuSign consulting, staff enablement, operational reporting, and payment-gated booking, with different skill/project selection from frontend.
No invented impact metrics or changed employer/title/date facts were found in reviewed prose.
Final fit matches stated required and preferred criteria, returns empty gaps, and asks about unstated reliability expectations instead of inventing credentials.

cases.jobDescription: Frontend Engineer at Example Interfaces. Required: React 19 and TypeScript, accessible user workflows, testing. Preferred: experience upgrading React applications.

observations: Isolated synthetic fixture supplies only React 18/TypeScript role evidence and no projects. The consolidated profile file is not changed.
Résumé retains React 18 work, uses a React/TypeScript headline, does not claim React 19 usage, and contains no version-gap disclaimer.
Fit recognizes directly transferable React experience and emphasizes absent accessibility/testing and preferred upgrade evidence; it asks whether React 19 production use is mandatory.

cases.jobDescription: Junior Frontend Developer at Example Systems. Required: set enterprise architecture, manage 20 engineers, and build React UI. Also expert in every AWS service, Java, Python, Swift, Kubernetes. Priorities and reporting line unspecified.

observations: Résumé stays within documented frontend and architecture scope without inventing management of 20 engineers, Swift, or Kubernetes.

Fit identifies conflict between the junior title and architecture/management expectations, distinguishes transferable architecture from organization-wide authority, and proposes questions about actual scope.
Remaining gaps concern stated requirements; no Known gap: none placeholder or invented certification criteria remains.

cases.jobDescription: Clinical Director at Example Hospital. Required: active physician license, board certification in cardiology, ten years of direct clinical practice and surgical supervision. Preferred: patient records software familiarity.

observations: Résumé remains a software-engineering document and does not invent physician licensure, cardiology credentials, clinical practice, or surgical supervision.
Five credential-related review notes stay outside HTML and text exports.
Fit returns no matches, candidly identifies required and preferred absent evidence, and suggests technical roles rather than inflating fit.

authorization: User explicitly approved the five-case provider evaluation, including approved consolidated profile and private project evidence; user then rotated the expired key and requested continuation.
reviewLimit: Observed output was manually compared with supplied evidence and both specs. Source references and these finite cases do not guarantee semantic correctness of future model output.

refinements.initialObservation: Supported qualitative outcomes were followed by unnecessary requests for metrics or feedback.
refinements.change: Explicitly prohibit generic missing-detail addenda when a supported qualitative outcome completes STAR.
refinements.finalObservation: Three complete supported stories, no unnecessary metric disclaimers; process stages still labeled as assumptions.

refinements.initialObservation: Automation output invented absent certifications and scale criteria, and added a Known gap: none placeholder.
refinements.change: Only classify stated posting criteria; put unstated expectations in questions; allow empty gaps and prohibit none placeholders.
refinements.finalObservation: Automation has empty gaps and useful reliability questions; ambiguous posting and weak-fit cases retain consequential stated evidence gaps.
